summary.intent: Execute Phase 66 ('API Schema Cutover, Publish Gate & Tombstone') of the CipherBox GSD workflow — 9 plans across 5 waves implementing atomic CAS/tombstone IPNS publish, share descriptor-ref model cutover, schema migration, API client regeneration, and sdk-core/web compile fixes.
summary.outcome: All 9 plans executed and committed across 5 waves; all gates passed (API build green, full monorepo typecheck exit 0, API jest 767/0, e2e 5/5); verification scored 6/6 must-haves with all 7 requirement IDs satisfied; phase 66 marked complete, next phase 67.

repo: worktree.baseRef='head' means worktrees fork from live HEAD — no base-mismatch halts after inter-wave merges advance HEAD past origin/HEAD
Wave 1→2 is intentionally an intermediate-red API build by design (type foundation lands before logic rewrite); post-merge gate should run targeted typecheck, not full build, in this window
API uses DB 'cipherbox_test' (apps/api/.env DB_DATABASE), not 'cipherbox'; psql helpers seeding test preconditions must target 'cipherbox_test'
API TEST_LOGIN_SECRET='e2e-test-secret-ci-only'; sdk-e2e harness SDK_E2E_SECRET defaults to 'e2e-test-secret-do-not-use-in-production' — they must be aligned before e2e runs

Ed25519 identity IPNS records do not embed pubKey in the wire format (the name IS the key); the API controller's hasSigData gate on signatureV2 && data && pubKey silently fails closed for all network-sourced records unless pubKey is supplemented from the ipnsName

The DB path for IPNS resolve already supplements pubKey via publicKeyFromIpnsName (codec); the network/seqFloor path did not, causing TEE-05 at-floor-serve to fail closed even with correct seq floor logic

TypeORM 0.3.28 compares migration row count (DB) vs file count (code) to detect pending migrations; a duplicate row causes a false 'no pending migrations' — requires direct psql DDL + manual migration record insert
pnpm test:single in sdk-e2e uses --testPathPattern which vitest 3.x removed; use positional pattern argument to vitest directly instead

api:generate's trailing pnpm lint:fix runs eslint repo-wide; running it before Wave 4 (web/sdk-core still broken) would exit non-zero even though regeneration succeeds — executor must be briefed to treat lint failure as non-blocking
cipherbox-mock-ipns-routing (:3001) was unhealthy during the session; tests routing through it depend on it being available

code.finding: Orphaned ShareKey import (line 32) and entities array registration (line 98) not cleaned up by plan 66-03 which deleted the entity — required orchestrator post-merge fix
seqFloor gate for shared-folder resolve: gates on BigInt(networkSeq) >= BigInt(seqFloor), fail-closed branch when below floor — logic is correct per §6.5

hasSigData = signatureV2 && data && pubKey gates whether sig fields are included in resolve response; Ed25519 network records lack embedded pubKey so gate always fails, causing fail-closed even on at-floor-serve
Ed25519 records intentionally omit pubKey from parse output (name IS the key); supplementing it from ipnsName in ipns.service.ts is the correct fix, mirroring the DB codec path
Publish PUTs signed record bytes to delegated routing (mock); mock returns them verbatim — mock itself doesn't strip signatures, stripping happened in controller gating
Second orphaned ShareKey import (deleted entity); not caught by 66-03 plan's files_modified list — executor auto-fixed it before running api:generate
After 66-02 replaced findOne/save with createQueryBuilder().update() (atomic CAS), 28 unit tests were stale (mock lacked createQueryBuilder); required a separate test-alignment subagent pass

workflow: Serialize git worktree add calls (one at a time per message) to avoid .git/config.lock races when dispatching parallel executor subagents
The worktree-safety.cjs deletion guard is unconditional (no override flag) — any branch with whole-file deletions forces manual merge even when deletions are correct and intended
cleanup-wave helper aborts the entire wave at the first deletion-flagged branch, so two legitimate-deletion waves both require manual merge of all branches
Single-plan waves should run sequentially on the main tree (no parallelism benefit; avoids worktree footguns for api:generate and live-DB operations)
api:generate must run on the main tree, not in a worktree — generated api-client output belongs in the main tree for Wave 4+ to consume
Concurrent sdk-e2e suite runs must be the orchestrator's gate, not a subagent's task — RAM starvation risk documented in D-08
Post-merge tracking updates should be deferred until the build is green after the relevant wave, not immediately after each plan marks complete
When a plan explicitly defers behavioral proof to a later e2e suite (66-02 → 66-09), the unit spec updates are also deferred — but CI-blocking stale mocks must be fixed before moving forward
Bash tool default 2-minute timeout is insufficient for full monorepo typecheck on large TypeScript repos — always pass explicit timeout_ms for typecheck/build steps

friction: Deletion guard in worktree-safety.cjs has no override flag — forced manual merge of Wave 1 and Wave 2 branches despite deletions being fully within declared plan scope
Two orphaned ShareKey references (app.module.ts, generate-openapi.ts) were not in any plan's files_modified, requiring unplanned orchestrator/executor fixes
28 stale ipns.service.spec.ts unit tests blocked the Wave 2 post-merge gate, requiring an unplanned test-alignment subagent before proceeding
TypeORM false 'no pending migrations' due to a duplicate WidenShareKeyType row forced direct psql DDL execution and manual migration record insertion
sdk-e2e auth secret mismatch (API uses 'e2e-test-secret-ci-only', harness defaults to a different value) caused all e2e tests to fail with 401 on first run
Test 15 psql seeding targeted the wrong database ('cipherbox' vs 'cipherbox_test'), seeding rows the API never read

Ed25519 IPNS records lack embedded pubKey in wire format, causing TEE-05 at-floor-serve to fail closed — required diagnosing through controller, parser, mock, and routing layers before identifying the supplement-from-name fix
pnpm test:single script is broken in vitest 3.x (removed --testPathPattern flag) — caused a silent no-op pass on first e2e run attempt
Bash 2-minute default timeout hit during post-completion typecheck, requiring a re-run with explicit timeout
mock-ipns-routing was unhealthy during execution, adding uncertainty to network-record routing behavior diagnosis

mock-ipns-routing unhealthy state should be investigated — production delegated routing (e.g. someguy) also returns Ed25519 records without embedded pubKey, so the pubKey supplement fix in ipns.service.ts is load-bearing in production too
The cleanup-wave helper's unconditional deletion gate creates recurring friction for phases with intentional file deletions — worth adding a per-wave allow-list or a --allow-deletions flag
